MikroTik CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS – High-Performance 10G/25G Cloud Core Router

Enterprise-Grade Fiber Router for High-Speed Networks

The MikroTik CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS is a powerful Cloud Core Router designed for ISPs, data centers, and high-performance networking environments. Equipped with an Annapurna Labs Alpine AL32400 Cortex-A57 Quad-Core CPU (1.7GHz per core) and 4GB RAM, this router ensures lightning-fast data processing, advanced routing, and seamless traffic management.


Featuring 12 x 10G SFP+ ports and 2 x 25G SFP28 cages, the CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS is ideal for high-bandwidth fiber networks, enterprise infrastructure, and high-performance cloud applications.


Key Features 

  • Ultra-Fast Networking Performance – Annapurna Labs AL32400 Quad-Core Cortex-A57 CPU (1.7GHz per core) for high-speed data handling.
  • High-Capacity Fiber Connectivity – 12 x 10Gbps SFP+ ports & 2 x 25Gbps SFP28 ports for scalable, high-speed networking.
  • Gigabit RJ45 Management Port – 1 x Gigabit Ethernet port for additional connectivity.
  • 4GB DDR4 RAM & 128MB NAND Storage – Ensures smooth and reliable performance (RouterOS v6: 1792MB, RouterOS v7: 4GB).
  • RouterOS L6 License – Supports advanced routing, VLAN, firewall, VPN, and network security features.
  • Enterprise-Grade Redundancy – Dual Redundant Power Supply ensures maximum uptime and reliability.
  • 1U Rackmount Case – Compact rack-mountable design for easy deployment in enterprise environments.
  • Made in Latvia – Manufactured by MikroTik, ensuring top-tier build quality and durability.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Peace of mind with a one-year manufacturer warranty.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS
  • CPU: Annapurna Labs Alpine AL32400 Quad-Core Cortex-A57 (1.7GHz per core)
  • RAM: 4GB DDR4 RAM (RouterOS v6: 1792MB / RouterOS v7: 4GB)
  • Storage: 128MB NAND
  • Ethernet Ports: 1 x Gigabit RJ45
  • SFP+ Ports: 12 x 10Gbps SFP+ Cages
  • SFP28 Ports: 2 x 25Gbps SFP28 Cages
  • Operating System: RouterOS L6
  • Power Supply: Dual Redundant Power Supply
  • Enclosure: 1U Rackmount Case
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • ISP & Data Centers – Perfect for high-speed fiber-based networking.
  • Enterprise Networks – Ideal for large-scale corporate and cloud infrastructures.
  • 0G & 25G Fiber Deployment – Supports high-bandwidth traffic with ultra-low latency.
  • High-Performance Routing & VPN – Handles advanced routing, VLAN, firewall, and VPN.
  • Mission-Critical Networks – Dual redundant power supply for maximum uptime.


Why Choose MikroTik CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS?

  • Next-Gen Fiber Networking – 12 x 10G SFP+ & 2 x 25G SFP28 for blazing-fast connectivity.
  • Powerful Processing – Annapurna Labs CPU & 4GB RAM ensure efficient network operations.
  • Enterprise Reliability – Dual power supply & rackmount design for stable deployment.
  • Future-Proof Solution – Supports scalable high-speed networking for growing businesses.
